description: Analyze NetSuite accounts-payable vendor bill lifecycle performance through the available MCP connector: days-to-pay including prepayment applications, first cash payment versus final settlement, approval duration, entry lag, payment-terms compliance, open-bill aging, trends and outliers. Use for AP processing-time, payment-speed, slow-vendor, or bill lifecycle questions and dashboards, including “invoice” when the context is AP. Read-only analytics; does not create or approve payments. Use payment prioritization when the user wants to decide which bills to pay next.
name: netsuite-vendor-bill-processing-time
